capabilities: Tag scene notes with the plotlines they progress
Display plotlines grouped by their tag in a Plotline View
Reorder scenes by dragging and dropping cards in an Act Overview
Rename scene files automatically when scenes are reordered
Restrict and order plotlines via a 00-00 TAG ORDER note
extras: Scene notes must follow the ##-## SCENE NAME naming pattern (e.g. 04-03 My Scene); non-integer act or scene numbers are unsupported and may corrupt the views.
intentEvidence: Why not use XYZ? You may. I want a minimal feature set.
motivation: The author wanted a minimal feature set and data kept in plain note titles and tags so it stays maintainable with vanilla Obsidian and filesystem tools.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track which plotlines a scene advances or to view and reorder scenes chronologically across acts.
summary: Plotline tracker that organizes scene notes into acts and plotlines using a strict file naming convention and tags.
